feel: Ctrl+K inserting by name is fast, and R to wrap a row worked.

But I could not select anything from the keyboard: arrows say 'Select an element first'; F6 cycles 7 regions and never reaches the canvas or the Layers tree; Tab walks all 74 palette tiles one by one; opening Layers from Ctrl+K leaves the focus nowhere.
Ctrl+A happened to select the section (the only child). On a real page that trick selects everything.
The shortcuts panel is complete and readable.
wish: F6 reaching the canvas and the Layers tree; arrows starting from the page when nothing is selected.

issues.what: Keyboard users cannot reach the canvas or the Layers tree: F6 cycles 7 regions without them, arrows need a selection, Tab walks every palette tile (no roving focus), opening Layers drops the focus
The command bar cannot switch pages or select a layer by name

notes: 0 mouse gestures. Escape before Ctrl+K cleared the selection in the first try (undone). The only way found to select an element from the keyboard with nothing selected was Ctrl+A ('select all siblings').
